title: faint — popularize

phrases.translation: 由于…原因而衰弱；因…而昏厥

sentences.sentence: She slumped to the ground in a faint.
sentences.translation: 她跌倒在地上不醒人事。

sentences.sentence: Other signs of angina are nausea, sweating, feeling faint and shortness of breath.
sentences.translation: 心绞痛的其他征兆是恶心、出汗、感觉虚弱晕眩和气短。

sentences.sentence: It sounds as though you enjoyed Peru.
sentences.translation: 这听起来好像你喜欢秘鲁。

sentences.sentence: Well, in Peru you had to negotiate like that to get the freshest fish at the market.
sentences.translation: 在秘鲁你必须这样还价你才能在市场上拿到最新鲜的鱼。

sentences.sentence: opera diva Jessye Norman
sentences.translation: 著名歌剧女歌唱家杰茜·诺曼

sentences.sentence: a nonstop flight to Los Angeles
sentences.translation: 直飞洛杉矶的航班

sentences.sentence: Amy and her group had driven nonstop through Spain.
sentences.translation: 艾米和她的小组成员一刻不停地开车穿过西班牙。

sentences.sentence: He had beautiful skin, with rosy cheeks, blue eyes, rimless round bifocal spectacles, resting on the tip of his nose.
sentences.translation: 他皮肤很好，面颊红润，眼睛深蓝，鼻梁上架着一副无框双焦眼镜。

sentences.sentence: The entire arrangement makes it easy for this bifocal fish to spot a tasty bug flying above the water, or a bit of algae below.
sentences.translation: 这个构造使四眼鱼能够很轻松地发现一只从水面飞过的美味的虫子，或者水面下的一点水藻。

sentences.sentence: He also made the first pair of bifocal glasses and invented a musical instrument called the glass harmonica and the stepladder chair.
sentences.translation: 他还制作了双光眼镜，以及自己命名为玻璃口琴的乐器和活动梯子。

sentences.sentence: Then Mrs. McAlister grabbed a shovel in the yard and swung it at the cougar.
sentences.translation: 于是阿里斯特太太抓起后院的一把铁锹对着美洲狮挥来挥去。

sentences.sentence: Finally, the cougar ran off and Mrs. McAlister held her children and was thankful they were safe.
sentences.translation: 最后美洲狮跑开了，阿里斯特太太抱着她的孩子，很欣慰他们都平安无事。

sentences.sentence: Now they ought to be listed with other endangered species like the Eastern cougar and Kemp's Ridley turtle.
sentences.translation: 如今，它们应该同濒临灭绝东部美洲狮和肯氏龟一起列入濒危物种的名录。

sentences.sentence: a very versatile performer
sentences.translation: 多才多艺的表演者

sentences.sentence: a more versatile workforce
sentences.translation: 技术更全面的劳动力

sentences.sentence: smeared windows
sentences.translation: 脏了的窗户

phrases.translation: 智力障碍的；精神障碍的

sentences.sentence: Above all be mentally prepared for the rigors of each trading day from the time you get up each morning until you go to bed at night.
sentences.translation: 最重要的是在精神上对每个交易日的严峻场面作好准备，从每天早晨你爬起来，一直到晚上回到床上。

translations.translation: 涂去, 删除, 使湮没

sentences.sentence: It is conceivable that you may get full compensation, but it’s not likely.
sentences.translation: 你可能会得到全额赔偿，但可能性不大。

sentences.sentence: We were discussing the problems from every conceivable angle.
sentences.translation: 我们正在从各个能想到的角度对问题进行讨论。

translations.translation: 国际性地, 在国际间

sentences.sentence: These days businesses have to be able to compete internationally.
sentences.translation: 如今，企业必须要有实力参与国际竞争。

sentences.sentence: ...his cold greenish eyes.
sentences.translation: ...他冷酷的浅绿色眼睛。

sentences.sentence: a succinct explanation
sentences.translation: 简明扼要的解释

sentences.sentence: Fresno is close to the midway point between LA and San Francisco.
sentences.translation: 弗雷斯诺位于接进洛杉矶和旧金山的中间点。

sentences.sentence: The studio is midway between his aunt's old home and his cottage.
sentences.translation: 那个工作室位于他姑姑的老房子和他的小屋中间。

sentences.sentence: one of the unsung heroes of French politics
sentences.translation: 法国政坛的一位无名英雄

sentences.sentence: For one thing, they’re not confined to rats or to the fungicide he fed them.
sentences.translation: 一方面，他们不局限于他所喂养的老鼠及他喂给老鼠的杀菌剂。

sentences.sentence: Spraying an iprodione fungicide on the nests after they’re taken out of the nesting boards “reduced chalkbrood levels by up to 50 percent—with no measurable loss of young,” she reports.
sentences.translation: 她报告说，把巢穴从巢套板上拆下来用杀菌剂异菌脲喷洒后“白垩病发病率就会减少50%——没有检测到幼虫死亡。”

sentences.sentence: The environmental exposure doesn’t have to be as extreme as chowing down on a fungicide.
sentences.translation: 环境暴露必定不像大量食入杀菌剂一样。

sentences.sentence: Skinner was the psychologist who popularized behavior modification.
sentences.translation: 斯金纳就是那位使行为矫正概念得到普及的心理学家。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 292 单元

faint
音标：英 /feɪnt/  美 /fent/
n. 昏晕
v. 昏晕
adj. 头晕的
短语：faint scent — 清香
短语：faint with — 由于…原因而衰弱；因…而昏厥
例句：She slumped to the ground in a faint.
她跌倒在地上不醒人事。
例句：Other signs of angina are nausea, sweating, feeling faint and shortness of breath.
心绞痛的其他征兆是恶心、出汗、感觉虚弱晕眩和气短。

Peru
音标：英 /pəˈruː/  美 /pə'rʊ/
n. 秘鲁
短语：from china to peru — 到处，遍天下
例句：It sounds as though you enjoyed Peru.
这听起来好像你喜欢秘鲁。
例句：Well, in Peru you had to negotiate like that to get the freshest fish at the market.
在秘鲁你必须这样还价你才能在市场上拿到最新鲜的鱼。

diva
音标：英 /'diːvə/  美 /'divə/
n. 歌剧中的首席女主角
例句：opera diva Jessye Norman
著名歌剧女歌唱家杰茜·诺曼

nonstop
音标：英 /'nɔn'stɔp/  美 /nɑn'stɑp/
adj. 不断的,直达的
adv. 不休息地
短语：nonstop flight — 不着陆飞行
例句：a nonstop flight to Los Angeles
直飞洛杉矶的航班
例句：Amy and her group had driven nonstop through Spain.
艾米和她的小组成员一刻不停地开车穿过西班牙。

bifocal
音标：英 /baɪ'fəʊk(ə)l/  美 /'baɪ'fokl/
adj. 双焦点的
例句：He had beautiful skin, with rosy cheeks, blue eyes, rimless round bifocal spectacles, resting on the tip of his nose.
他皮肤很好，面颊红润，眼睛深蓝，鼻梁上架着一副无框双焦眼镜。
例句：The entire arrangement makes it easy for this bifocal fish to spot a tasty bug flying above the water, or a bit of algae below.
这个构造使四眼鱼能够很轻松地发现一只从水面飞过的美味的虫子，或者水面下的一点水藻。
例句：He also made the first pair of bifocal glasses and invented a musical instrument called the glass harmonica and the stepladder chair.
他还制作了双光眼镜，以及自己命名为玻璃口琴的乐器和活动梯子。

cougar
音标：英 /'kuːgə/  美 /'kuɡɚ/
n. [动]美洲狮(尤指Felis concolor)
例句：Then Mrs. McAlister grabbed a shovel in the yard and swung it at the cougar.
于是阿里斯特太太抓起后院的一把铁锹对着美洲狮挥来挥去。
例句：Finally, the cougar ran off and Mrs. McAlister held her children and was thankful they were safe.
最后美洲狮跑开了，阿里斯特太太抱着她的孩子，很欣慰他们都平安无事。
例句：Now they ought to be listed with other endangered species like the Eastern cougar and Kemp's Ridley turtle.
如今，它们应该同濒临灭绝东部美洲狮和肯氏龟一起列入濒危物种的名录。

versatile
音标：英 /'vɜːsətaɪl/  美 /'vɝsətl/
adj. 多才多艺的,万能的
短语：versatile person — 通才
例句：a very versatile performer
多才多艺的表演者
例句：a more versatile workforce
技术更全面的劳动力

smear
音标：英 /smɪə/  美 /smɪr/
v. 涂污,弄脏
n. 油迹, 涂片
短语：pap smear — 子宫颈抹片检查
短语：blood smear — 血涂片；血液涂片
例句：smeared windows
脏了的窗户

ocher
音标：英 /'əʊkə/  美 /'okɚ/
n. 黄土, 赭土

mentally
音标：英 /'ment(ə)lɪ/  美 /'mɛntli/
adv. 精神上, 智力上
短语：mentally ill — 精神病患者
短语：mentally retarded — 智障；智力迟钝
短语：mentally handicapped — 智力障碍的；精神障碍的
例句：Above all be mentally prepared for the rigors of each trading day from the time you get up each morning until you go to bed at night.
最重要的是在精神上对每个交易日的严峻场面作好准备，从每天早晨你爬起来，一直到晚上回到床上。

obliterate
音标：英 /ə'blɪtəreɪt/  美 /ə'blɪtə'ret/
v. 涂去, 删除, 使湮没

aspiration
音标：英 /æspə'reɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /'æspə'reʃən/
n. 热望, 渴望
短语：aspiration biopsy — 针吸活组织检查
短语：aspiration pneumonia — [医]吸入性肺炎

conceivable
音标：英 /kən'siːvəb(ə)l/  美 /kən'sivəbl/
adj. 可能的,想得到的
例句：It is conceivable that you may get full compensation, but it’s not likely.
你可能会得到全额赔偿，但可能性不大。
例句：We were discussing the problems from every conceivable angle.
我们正在从各个能想到的角度对问题进行讨论。

internationally
adv. 国际性地, 在国际间
例句：These days businesses have to be able to compete internationally.
如今，企业必须要有实力参与国际竞争。

greenish
音标：美 /'ɡrinɪʃ/
adj. 呈绿色的
短语：greenish yellow — 青黄色
例句：...his cold greenish eyes.
...他冷酷的浅绿色眼睛。

succinct
音标：英 /sək'sɪŋ(k)t/  美 /sək'sɪŋkt/
adj. 简洁的, 紧身的
例句：a succinct explanation
简明扼要的解释

midway
音标：英 /'mɪdweɪ; mɪd'weɪ/  美 /'mɪd'we/
n. 中途,半路
adj. 中途的
adv. 在中途
例句：Fresno is close to the midway point between LA and San Francisco.
弗雷斯诺位于接进洛杉矶和旧金山的中间点。
例句：The studio is midway between his aunt's old home and his cottage.
那个工作室位于他姑姑的老房子和他的小屋中间。

unsung
音标：英 /ʌn'sʌŋ/  美 /,ʌn'sʌŋ/
adj. 未唱的,未赞颂的
例句：one of the unsung heroes of French politics
法国政坛的一位无名英雄

fungicide
音标：英 /'fʌn(d)ʒɪsaɪd; 'fʌŋgɪ-/  美 /'fʌŋgə'saɪd/
n. 杀真菌剂
例句：For one thing, they’re not confined to rats or to the fungicide he fed them.
一方面，他们不局限于他所喂养的老鼠及他喂给老鼠的杀菌剂。
例句：Spraying an iprodione fungicide on the nests after they’re taken out of the nesting boards “reduced chalkbrood levels by up to 50 percent—with no measurable loss of young,” she reports.
她报告说，把巢穴从巢套板上拆下来用杀菌剂异菌脲喷洒后“白垩病发病率就会减少50%——没有检测到幼虫死亡。”
例句：The environmental exposure doesn’t have to be as extreme as chowing down on a fungicide.
环境暴露必定不像大量食入杀菌剂一样。

popularize
音标：英 /'pɔpjuləraiz/  美 /'pɑpjələraɪz/
v. 普及
例句：Skinner was the psychologist who popularized behavior modification.
斯金纳就是那位使行为矫正概念得到普及的心理学家。
